note: all characters are drawn and filmed at least M size; XS and S are scaled down after the split

roles.note: casters only perform the casting motion in the attack clip; the vfx and a projectile still are added later (enemy ranged: shoot_side + projectile)

walk.note: start image used as the last frame too, so the walk loops; side view only (walk down and up need front and back grids)

split.frames: frames/<action>/<id>/frames/f01..f13.png (RGBA 396x512, feet anchor y 402, x 198), sheet.png, preview.gif

known_issues: attack: the model draws a flame crescent swing trail around frame 5 on the Cinder Goblin, Salamander Warrior, Blaze Duelist and Spark Imp (attached to the character; to be erased per frame)
attack: Flame Drake rears up instead of thrusting its head forward; the last frame returns to the standing pose
die: clean, the same fall for all ten (hound and drake on their sides, slime a flat puddle)
walk: stays in its cell (centre drift 1-13 px over the clip), no overlap; the Obsidian Golem and the Blaze Duelist turn their body toward the viewer in some frames
